encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

cRefPattern.p: This pointer pattern extracts lines within fragments.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

lg.l: ὃς μέλανα ποιεῖν ζωμὸν οὐκ ἠπίστατο,
θρῖον δὲ καὶ κάνδαυλον ἢ τούτων τι τῶν

div.note: Athenaeus 12, 517 a μνημονεύει τοῦ κανδαύλου . . . καὶ Νικόστρατος ἐν Μαγείρῳ ὃς — κάνδαυλον. et 14, 664 c Νικόστρατος . . . καὶ ἐν Μαγείρῳ θρῖον κτλ. in unum fragmentum coniunxit Mein.

2. θρῖον et κάνδυλον A 664. 3. οὐδ’ ἕτερον Mein. neutrum verum. nam post sententiam negativam οὐκ ἠπίστατο, verba θρῖον δὲ καὶ κάνδαυλον ἢ τούτων τι inferri non poterant nisi adiecta gradatione item negativa. scribendum est οὐδ’ ἴκταρ εἶδε. cf. Aesch. Ag. 117. Eumen. 988 et proverbia οὐδ’ ἴκταρ βάλλει Plat. Reip. 9, 575 c et οὐδ’ ἴκταρ ἥκει. Schol. Plat. ibid. cf. Ruhnk. Tim. 149. Blomfield. Gloss. Ag. 114 suae ed. — de candaulo Lydio copiosius Athenaeus paullo ante egerat 516 cd.
